task.prompt: Has the rise of algorithmic news selection made the idea of objective news obsolete? Offer a critical commentary that distinguishes between different senses of objectivity.
instructions: Write about 340-400 words (at least 280).
You have about 45 minutes.
Make sure you cover all of the points below.
You are writing for: a professional and academic readership. Style: formal, scholarly.
required_points: define at least two senses of objectivity
analyse how algorithmic selection affects each

task.title: Address on space spending
task.scenario: You have been invited to give a short written address at a conference on science policy. The audience includes scientists, officials and journalists.
task.prompt: Write the text of an address in which you argue for or against the view that large public spending on space exploration is justified while urgent problems remain on Earth.
instructions: Write about 320-380 words (at least 260).
You have about 45 minutes.
Make sure you cover all of the points below.

task.title: Public health and personal freedom
task.scenario: During a public health debate, one speaker argued that individual freedom must always give way to the collective good.
task.prompt: 'Where public health is at stake, individual freedom must give way.' Discuss critically, with attention to the principles, limits and consequences of such a position.
instructions: Write about 340-400 words (at least 280).
You have about 45 minutes.
Make sure you cover all of the points below.
You are writing for: an academic readership. Style: formal, scholarly.
required_points: unpack the principle in the claim
identify where the line might reasonably be drawn
present a precise and qualified conclusion
